name: Life with Mary
source:
In LIFE WITH MARY, you take control of our MC who’s lived a pretty stale life, albeit successful with his career. But your mundane existence is changed when your longtime friend unexpectedly drops his daughter off to live with you, so she can attend a music school in the city.

How will your relationship progress living with this smart, sassy and beautiful 18-year-old progress? If it does, she might be the spark your life has been missing this entire time… Or maybe not at all and her vixen of a best friend Simone might be more to your liking.
Either way, if you do choose one of the gorgeous young girls as your love interest, there might be others that might have a problem with your newfound relationships and even threaten them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《与玛丽共度生活》中，你将控制我们的主人公。他的人生相当乏味，但事业颇为成功。然而，平淡的生活被一位老朋友意外打破：朋友把女儿送来与你同住，好让她在城里上音乐学校。

和这个聪明、泼辣又美丽的十八岁女孩一起生活，你们的关系会如何发展？如果进展顺利，她或许就是你整个人生一直缺少的火花……也可能完全不是，而她那位妖艳的好友西蒙娜更合你的口味。

无论如何，如果你选择其中一位漂亮女孩作为恋爱对象，可能会有人对你们的新关系感到不满，甚至威胁要拆散你们。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1428560/]Steam[/url]]
